Specification: This specification models a tiny one-variable system with a single state variable `clock` over Boolean values. It defines two recursive operators, `Check` and `Flip`, and uses them to express a type predicate, an initial-state predicate, and a separate constraint-like state predicate. The behavior consists of a transition that flips the Boolean value of `clock`, while comments note TLC coverage behavior for the recursive operator call appearing in `Init`.
IfThenElse: IF n = 0 THEN c \in BOOLEAN ELSE Check(c, n - 1)
IF n = 0 THEN v = ~b ELSE Flip(v, b, n - 1)
